question: For the disputed transaction, what amount and asset does the record show delivered to the destination wallet (for example 1562.87 USDT)?
For the disputed transaction, what delivery timestamp does the record show for the transfer to the destination wallet, exactly as printed?
For the disputed transaction, which block number does the record show the transfer was included in?

Does the record show an earlier transfer to the same destination wallet, other than the disputed transaction? If so, give its identifiers exactly as printed - date and time, amount and asset, transaction hash, and any acquirer reference number or order id.

In what currency is that total - the total amount charged to the card for the disputed transaction, fees included - stated? Give the ISO 4217 code (for example USD, GBP, TWD); NOT_FOUND if no currency is stated.
Does the issuer's questionnaire answer "Yes" to whether the cardholder cancelled prior to the expected delivery or receipt date? TRUE for Yes, FALSE for No; NOT_FOUND if the form does not ask it.
Does the issuer's questionnaire answer "Yes" to whether the merchandise was delivered to the incorrect location? TRUE for Yes, FALSE for No; NOT_FOUND if the form does not ask it.

Does the issuer's questionnaire answer "Yes" to whether the merchant is in bankruptcy or liquidation? TRUE for Yes, FALSE for No; NOT_FOUND if the form does not ask it. This is the issuer's assertion only, not a public insolvency record.

What claim does the issuer's questionnaire certify, derived from its Yes/No answers? Exactly one of NOT_RECEIVED, LATE_DELIVERY, CANCELLED_BY_CARDHOLDER, CANCELLED_BY_MERCHANT — the same set as dispute.claimType, which is the judged reading of the narrative; this key is the issuer's form. Precedence: cardholder cancelled prior, then merchant cancelled, then late, then not received. Absent when any input is absent.

Does the address on the proof of delivery match the agreed delivery address after normalisation (upper-case, punctuation stripped, whitespace collapsed, country suffix removed)? TRUE if equal, or if the postcode/ZIP tokens and the street-number tokens both match; otherwise FALSE. Absent when either address is absent.

Does the tracking number on the proof of delivery equal any tracking number the despatch record assigned to the shipment (upper-case, spaces removed; the despatch list is ";" separated)? TRUE / FALSE; absent when either is absent.
Does the destination wallet address on the chain record equal the wallet address the merchant's order record or receipt states, after trimming? TRUE / FALSE; absent when either is absent.

Does the Issuer's dispute material record the Cardholder complaining that the FLIGHT DID NOT TAKE PLACE, as opposed to that they were denied boarding, missed it, or had their booking cancelled? Judge only from issuer-supplied dispute material - never from the merchant's flight record.

Do the documents show that the applicable bond or insurance scheme was insufficient to reimburse the claimed travel-services loss? Count only express advice that no funds are available, limits are exhausted, or coverage is insufficient; a pending claim or an absence of response is not insufficiency.

Does the total charged to the card on the ramp record equal the disputed transaction amount within the crypto amount tolerance (Java constant), in the same currency? TRUE / FALSE; absent when either amount or either currency is absent, or the currencies differ.

Does the issuer's questionnaire answer "Yes" to whether the purchase was a third-party gift card without an expiration date where the goods or services were not provided due to the third party's insolvency? TRUE for Yes, FALSE for No; NOT_FOUND if the form does not ask it.

Does the issuer's questionnaire answer "Yes" to whether non-fiat currency or NFTs were not successfully delivered to the destination wallet address supplied by the cardholder at the time of the transaction? TRUE for Yes, FALSE for No; NOT_FOUND if the form does not ask it.

Does the merchant's own material state that the merchandise was not delivered, is lost, or is still under carrier investigation? Count only the merchant's or its agent's own words - a case comment, a letter, an internal note reproduced in the pack - not the cardholder's account of them, and not the carrier's own tracking status.

Does the airline or flight record show that the flight the cardholder paid for on the disputed transaction departed? If the record shows only a replacement, reissued or substitute flight, answer FALSE for the original.

Which record supplies the delivery facts relied on — the carrier's own record (tracking page, delivery scan, signature, POD photo) or the merchant's despatch/shipping record? If any delivery fact (delivery status, date, or address) had to be taken from the merchant's own record, answer MERCHANT_OWN; otherwise CARRIER. Answer exactly one of CARRIER, MERCHANT_OWN.
Did the Cardholder attempt to resolve the dispute with the Merchant, the Merchant's liquidator, the Ramp Provider, or its Conversion Affiliate as applicable, before the Issuer initiated the Dispute?
Had the credit already settled when the Issuer raised the Dispute?
Was the Transaction in a Card-Present Environment?
Is the disputed amount the cash-back portion of a Visa Cash-Back Transaction?
Was the transaction made in a card-present or card-absent environment? Answer exactly one of: CARD_PRESENT, CARD_ABSENT.
Is a public insolvency record for the supplying party on file for this case (any value of supplyingParty.insolventOrBankrupt on the sheet)?

Does anything the Issuer submitted with this Dispute record the Cardholder stating the Transaction is fraudulent - that they did not make, authorise, or participate in it? Judge only from issuer-supplied material (dispute narrative, cardholder letter, issuer questionnaire or certification) - never from merchant records, the transaction record, or any classification of ours - and never infer fraud from the transaction, the merchant, or the amount.
Do the documents show that the Merchant was a ticket agency selling third-party event tickets for this Transaction?

What was purchased according to the issuer's questionnaire, derived from what it says was not received? MERCHANDISE gives PHYSICAL_MERCHANDISE; SERVICES gives SERVICES — the same set as dispute.purchaseCategory, which is the judged reading of the narrative. Absent when the form does not say.

What is the last date the cardholder expected to receive the merchandise or services, as stated on the issuer's questionnaire ("last expected receipt date")? ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); NOT_FOUND if absent.

What do the case documents show about the Merchant, Load Partner, or applicable supplying party's ability and willingness to provide the disputed merchandise or services? Answer exactly one of: WILLING_AND_ABLE, OFFERED_ON_BALANCE_PAYMENT, REFUSED, CANCELLED, NOT_ADDRESSED.
What does the delivery record say happened - DELIVERED, RETURNED_TO_SENDER or IN_TRANSIT? Read the carrier's record where a carrier was used, otherwise the merchant's own delivery record.

Does the cardholder's complaint concern the quality of merchandise or a service that was PROVIDED to them, rather than a failure to receive it? Judge only from the Issuer's dispute description and cardholder statement. If any part of the purchase is alleged never to have arrived at all, the answer is false.
Is the Transaction a Straight Through Processing Transaction?
Whose country's customs agency does the delivery or customs record show is holding the merchandise? Answer exactly one of: MERCHANT_COUNTRY, CARDHOLDER_COUNTRY, OTHER_COUNTRY, NONE, UNKNOWN.
Does the credit cover the disputed amount?
Was the purchase non-fiat currency (for example cryptocurrency) or non-fungible tokens?
How many calendar days after the Transaction Date was the Dispute raised?
On what date did the Cardholder receive the merchandise or services?
How many days after the agreed delivery date did the merchandise actually arrive?
Was the transaction an ATM cash disbursement?
For the disputed transaction, does the record show the non-fiat currency or NFT delivered to the wallet address the cardholder supplied at the time of the transaction?
What delivery or service date did the order promise?
For the disputed transaction, what destination wallet address does the record show was supplied by the Cardholder at the time of the Transaction?
Does the document show that the Merchant notified the Cardholder of the cancellation? [POC] Read from either side's correspondence.

Does the issuer-filed narrative state that the Cardholder's complaint is that they can no longer access the non-fiat currency or NFT after it was successfully delivered? Count inability to access, withdraw, transfer or use assets after documented successful delivery; do not count non-delivery to the supplied destination wallet.
What date is shown on the letter or advice from the bonding authority or insurance scheme?
Did the transaction carry a cash-back portion?
Was the transaction reversed instead of refunded?
Does the log tie the download or use to the purchaser - device ID, IP address, or account?
Had the Reversal already settled when the Issuer raised the Dispute?

Does the merchant record show the service being used - a login, a session, streamed minutes, or delivered work product? Count only a system or third-party record of the usage event itself (an identifier, a timestamp); a merchant's or issuer's own statement that the service was delivered or used is not evidence of usage.

Do the merchant's records contain the Cardholder stating that the matter is resolved, that they have been refunded and are content, or that they are withdrawing the dispute? Count only the merchant's own correspondence with the cardholder - not merchant assertions about the cardholder, and not inferred satisfaction.
Does the merchant record show the Cardholder or an authorized person attending at the agreed location?
Does the supplied contract show that a travel agency using a Visa Commercial Card Virtual Account had a contractual agreement with the T&E Merchant covering the terms for the specified services?

What delivery address does the proof of delivery show? Read the POSTAL ADDRESS ONLY - street, town, postcode and country. Do not include telephone numbers, e-mail addresses, account, order or customer numbers, or the labels of other fields printed beside it. Prefer the carrier's record; if the carrier record carries no address, read it from the merchant's despatch, shipping or delivery record classified as proof of delivery. Verbatim; NOT_FOUND if no address appears.
How long after the transaction was processed?
How much of the transaction was cash-back?
Has the Cardholder withdrawn the dispute?
How many calendar days after the reimbursement claim was submitted to the bonding authority or insurance scheme was the Dispute raised?
What address does the document identify as the agreed delivery or service location?
Was the disputed transaction processed as a partial Advance Payment Transaction?
Was the Transaction an Airline Transaction?
How many calendar days after the date of the letter or advice from the bonding authority or insurance scheme was the Dispute raised?
How many days after the agreed delivery date was the Dispute raised?
Do the documents show that the Transaction represented merchandise or services to be delivered or performed at a later date, or that the Dispute related to future services?
How many calendar days after the Merchant or service provider canceled the goods or services was the Dispute raised?
How many calendar days after the Cardholder returned or attempted to return the merchandise was the Dispute raised?
Does the document show that the Cardholder, traveler, or Issuer submitted a reimbursement claim to the relevant bonding authority or insurance scheme?
What date does the document show the Cardholder returned or attempted to return the merchandise?

Do the documents or public records show that the party responsible for supplying the disputed merchandise or services was insolvent or bankrupt? Count only a public or official record - an administration, liquidation, receivership or equivalent formal insolvency filing - showing the party responsible for supplying the disputed merchandise or services to be insolvent or bankrupt. Neither side's own assertion counts, and financial difficulty, delayed refunds or unresponsiveness are not insolvency.
What date does the document show the reimbursement request was submitted to the bonding authority or insurance scheme?
Does the document show that the Cardholder returned or attempted to return the merchandise?

For the disputed transaction, what is the blockchain transaction hash of the delivery shown on the record? Where the record covers more than one transfer, give only the hash of the transfer that matches the disputed transaction.
Does the document carry an acknowledgment from the Cardholder or an authorized person - a signature, PIN or collection code?
Does the document show that the disputed travel services were covered by a bonding authority or insurance scheme?

Did the cardholder cancel the merchandise or service before the expected delivery or service date? TRUE where the issuer's questionnaire certifies it (an admission against the issuer's interest) or where the cancellation date on record precedes the agreed date; otherwise the dates decide; the issuer's "No" resolves nothing (P29-27).
Did a credit settle for this card?
On what date did the Cardholder cancel, relative to the Transaction?
Is this an Automated Fuel Dispenser Transaction?

For the disputed transaction, what was the total amount charged to the card, in the card transaction currency, fees included - the figure the cardholder paid, not the crypto subtotal, not the network or processing fee line, not the crypto quantity? Give amount and currency exactly as printed; NOT_FOUND if no total is stated.

Does the proof of delivery carry the full delivery address? Derived from the delivery address on the proof of delivery: TRUE where it is present with a street token and a postcode in the merchant country's pattern ([POC] GB, IE, NL, ES, US), FALSE where present without them; absent where no address was read.
Does the document show that the Merchant agreed to deliver the goods or services at a later date rather than provide them at the time of purchase?
Do merchant-supplied order or payment records show that the remaining balance for the partial Advance Payment Transaction was paid?
Does the merchant-provided certification state that the Cardholder took the merchandise at the time of sale?
Does the merchant-provided evidence show that the future services were available?
What date does the document show the Merchant or service provider canceled the goods or services?
What does the issuer say the cardholder is disputing, in their own words?
